Can our heroes find him and stop Armageddon before it's too late?

trending_day.name: For All Mankind
trending_day.overview: Explore an aspirational world where NASA and the space program remained a priority and a focal point of our hopes and dreams as told through the lives of NASA astronauts, engineers, and their families.

trending_day.overview: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

trending_day.name: Outlander
trending_day.overview: The story of Claire Randall, a married combat nurse from 1945 who is mysteriously swept back in time to 1743, where she is immediately thrown into an unknown world where her life is threatened. trending_day.name: Soul Mate
trending_day.overview: In a moment of despair, Ryu Narutaki finds himself saved by Korean boxer Johan Hwang. As their wounded souls draw closer, their fates cruelly intertwine.

trending_day.name: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
trending_day.original_name: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
trending_day.overview: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school  student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds  himself transported to another world. Determined to  repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to  help the girl find something she's looking for.

trending_day.name: Daredevil: Born Again
trending_day.overview: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

trending_day.name: One Piece
trending_day.overview:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

trending_day.name: Welcome to Wrexham

trending_day.overview: Restless in the Florida Keys, Etta Tiger Jonze dreams of a life in Miami's glittering, sub-tropical kingdom. trending_day.name: The Rookie
trending_day.overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

trending_day.name: Unconditional
trending_day.overview: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

trending_day.overview: As drugs flood the streets of '90s Britain, a team of civil servants is thrust undercover to topple the gangs behind it.
